title: Feature Request: Allow model selection for built-in agents (currently appears to use Sonnet)
body: Built-in agents currently seem to use Sonnet regardless of the selected model in the main session. Since sub agents already support `model: inherit`, it would be great if: 1. Built-in agents could also use `model: inherit` to match the main session's model 2. Or add a setting to configure which model built-in agents should use This would help maintain consistency when using models like Opus throughout the workflow.
author: yamadashy
